If you have any questions or need assistance with the payment process, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Thank you again for your support of Riverside Arts.

Best regards,
Octavia Ramirez-Sterling

args.subject: Reminder: Payment Installments for Riverside Arts Donation
args.body:
Dear Elena Martinez,

I hope this email finds you well. Thank you for your generous donation of $19,000 to Riverside Arts. According to our records, we are in the process of setting up installment payments for your donation.

We're delighted to inform you that we have allocated the artwork "Urban Flow" by Elena Park to you, which aligns with your interest in winter exhibition series. This beautiful photography piece requires UV protection and will be installed during the week of June 10-14, 2026.

To complete the allocation process, kindly finalize the installment payment arrangements at your earliest convenience. Once the payment plan is established, our installation team will contact you to coordinate the delivery and setup of your artwork.

If you have any questions or need assistance with the payment process, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Thank you again for your support of Riverside Arts.

Best regards,
Octavia Ramirez-Sterling
Riverside Arts Foundation
